notes: New Dashboard: Orders Book on top. Big icons with a red notification number, like a phone app: 🔮 Orders Expected (buyers expected in the last month and the next month — late / coming / MT), P.P. Enterprise with its logo and 'x Bills Due', 📞 Today's Calls (late ones in red). Below them quick icons: Stock IN, Inward Entry, Create Invoice, New Order. The Backup card is gone: under the date and time at the top right it shows 'Backup done' in green or 'Error in backup' in red (bold); click it for Backup settings. A good backup clears the old error.
